talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $2.7M sold across 4 Form D filings this week, down 99% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Ecovia Renewables Inc. (Livonia, Other Technology) targeting $3M. Good question to ask: are founders in technology favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
Modular Devices Holdings, LLC disclosed a deal. It was one of 2 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan private funds assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

3 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $6M raised so far — led by Modular Devices Holdings, LLC (Business Combination (Form D)). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
